title: A stone block in the City of Gold gives no gold
description: A bomb in the City of Gold destroys a stone block and the gold temple block beside it. The temple block gives three gold chunks and a nugget; the stone block nothing, as level generation marked every stone block of a Temple level to break without a trace.
